module.name: Repeat Caller
module.description: Repeat Caller detects repeated inbound call journeys, creates actionable incidents, and supports GUI, email, and Alert Call notifications for FreePBX/PBXact 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *1.2.0* Fixes anonymous and withheld caller detection, Run Now feedback, and notifications continuing after incident acceptance. Moves Alert Call dialplan generation to FreePBX BMO and improves legacy dialplan cleanup during upgrades. *1.1.0* First signed FreePBX UK release. Adds Test Email, server-side pagination and sorting for incident and alert history, and fixes DID selection and email sender handling. *1.0.2* Adds native French Alert Calls, English fallback for unsupported languages, language availability indicators, and audio previews. *1.0.1* Fixes Alert Reminder sequencing, caller and DID rule editing, incident suppression, and Alert Call escalation. Expands snooze and monitoring controls.
